method: Reviewed all 56 listening questions against their transcripts and explanations. Visually checked December 2019 image choices 75 and 77 on source PDF page 15 and calendar question 80 on page 16. The PDF images confirm answers 2, 1, and 3 respectively, matching the attached transcript markers. For question 80, the calendar starts April 1 on Tuesday and April 2 on Wednesday as stated in the audio, so the third Wednesday is April 16 (choice 3). The user-provided answer reference on page 20 also lists 3. Text choices for questions 87–102 in both exams were recovered from transcript lines. The reference sheet is not an official JLPT key.

questions.explanation: Đáp án 3 — 「本当？一緒に探そうか」: “Thật à? Mình cùng tìm nhé?” Người kia lỡ vứt nhầm tài liệu cuộc họp nên lời đề nghị giúp tìm là phù hợp. Đáp án 1 hiểu nhầm rằng tài liệu có sai sót; đáp án 2 bảo đừng vứt, nhưng việc đó đã xảy ra. Khôi phục lựa chọn từ transcript.
